findings.message: The proxy and renamed backing DLL must be deployed atomically in one directory.
findings.mitigation: Verify both hashes from build_manifest.json before replacing a copied deployment.

findings.message: A newly built proxy does not inherit the source DLL Authenticode signature.
findings.mitigation: Sign and verify the built proxy under the deployment policy.

findings.message: Ordinal-only exports require linker NONAME support and ordinal-preserving verification.
findings.mitigation: Parse the built DLL export table before deployment.

findings.message: Some source exports already forward and will resolve through the backing DLL.
findings.mitigation: Validate the final forwarding chain on the target Windows version.

findings.message: The generated project rejects compiler targets other than x64.
findings.mitigation: Keep the CMake and preprocessor architecture guards enabled.

findings.message: Direct PE forwarders preserve calling boundaries without generated signature guesses.
findings.mitigation: Do not replace DEF forwarders with C wrappers unless exact prototypes are proven.
